title: Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions — Term and Price Schedule
content:
Every Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product is sold for a term of 12 calendar months, and the term starts 0 calendar days after purchase, that is, on the purchase date itself. The schedule below sets, for each of the six subscriptions, the price of one term and the forms of payment the company accepts for it.

## Schedule of term prices

| Subscription | Term (calendar months) | Days from purchase to start | Price of one term paid up front (USD) | Monthly billing available | Monthly installment (USD) | Summit Silver and higher discount on cash prices | Payable entirely in Summit miles | Miles price of one up-front term | Payable with a Crestline flight credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Bag Pass One | 12 | 0 | 499 | Yes | 45 | 0 percent | Yes | 50000 | No |
| Crestline Bag Pass Two | 12 | 0 | 749 | Yes | 69 | 0 percent | Yes | 75000 | No |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic | 12 | 0 | 549 | Yes | 49 | 10 percent | Yes | 55000 | No |
| Crestline Seat Pass Network | 12 | 0 | 849 | Yes | 79 | 10 percent | Yes | 85000 | No |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | 12 | 0 | 899 | Yes | 84 | 10 percent | No | 0 (not sold for miles) | No |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | 12 | 0 | 1299 | Yes | 119 | 10 percent | No | 0 (not sold for miles) | No |

## Forms of payment by subscription

The same figures, read by form of payment rather than by column:

- **Up front in cash.** Every subscription may be paid up front at its term price.
- **Monthly installments.** Every subscription may be billed monthly, at the monthly installment shown for it.
- **Summit miles.** The two Bag Passes and the two Seat Passes may be paid entirely in Summit miles, at 50000, 75000, 55000 and 85000 miles respectively for one up-front term. Neither Seat and Bag Pass is sold for miles; its miles price is shown as 0.
- **Flight credit.** No subscription may be paid with a Crestline flight credit.

## Notes to the schedule

- The Summit Silver and higher discount is a percentage of the cash price; it is 0 percent on both Bag Passes and 10 percent on the Seat Passes and the Seat and Bag Passes.
- The miles price is a number of Summit miles for one up-front term, not a cash amount.
- A term of 12 calendar months with 0 days to start means that a subscription bought on a given date has that same date as the first day of its term.
